scene street_noon
I wound up sitting in the office for a good hour after Makoto left, but it seems that my services as the least qualified guidance counselor to ever exist are not all that sought after.
But hey, at least I won't have to worry about that for the next couple days.
Tomorrow is Saturday, so I should finally have some free time to actually do things I want rather than just...hang around teenage girls all day.
Which, to be fair, is exactly what I'm going to be doing anyway. Just this time it will be out of my own free will and not determined by a schedule.
Either that or I won't be able to find anyone at all and I'll spend the whole day just aimlessly wandering around an unfamiliar town.
Something tells me my luck won't be that horrible, though.
I mean...look where I ended up. This world is every man's dream.
There are millions of people who would kill to walk even a day in my brand new shoes, and I'll be damned if I don't start walking as far as I can as fast I can.
The only question is how I'm going to leverage this new life to get what I want out of it.
There are ten girls in my class right now. And if what Ami said yesterday is true, more could show up at any time.
That said, the best course of action would be to try and...balance out my time with all of them, right?
Focusing too much on one will just wind up drawing attention to us. And even if most of the girls I've encountered so far are...eccentric, I doubt any of them would be okay with-
Well, pretty much any of the things I want to do at this point in time.
I'm sure the line will be different for everyone...I just have to figure out how thin or thick those lines are and the best methods to cross over them.
But that's a problem I'll figure out how to deal with once I actually encounter it.
For now, I should be heading home.
I remember Ami mentioning that she was going to have Ayane and Maya stay over tonight, but I doubt that means I'll be able to spend any time with either of them.
They're teenage girls after all. Chances are they'll just be...gossipping in Ami's room or whatever it is girls that age do.
Maybe I'll just go to sleep early tonight? The closer I get to having any free time, the better. And Saturday is less than twelve hours away at this point.
scene black
Yeah...
I think that's what I'll wind up doing tonight.
scene lr_noon
I let myself into the house after realizing that Ami forgot to lock the door.
And while my initial instinct is to storm into her room and reprimand her for enabling a situation that could result in her being raped and killed while I am not home, I decide against it.
Though, I do like the idea of being able to embarrass a girl I am apparently the guardian of in front of her friends.
I also, however, have not ruled out the idea of sleeping with her yet. And I feel that embarrassing her now would only serve to inhibit that budding desire of mine.
: What?! No way! You did not!
Yeah.
I'll just let girls be girls tonight.
I don't have to involve myself in everything.
Sometimes the best thing to do is just sit back and let things happen on their own.
scene black
Not just because the cogs in the background are already powering a machine built to pleasure me, but because being alone can be just as fulfilling as being with someone.
When I'm alone, I can fantasize about all I want. And, between you and I-
I have very quickly learned that being a high school teacher comes with its fair share of fantasies.
I hope no one minds if I take a few of those fantasies into the bathroom for a little while.
Meanwhile...
scene sleepover1
: And that's why I was permanently banned from the convenience store near the school!
scene sleepover2
: Well, that was...certainly a story.
: Umm...how many convenience stores have you been banned from now, Ayane? Six? Seven?
: Something like that, but it's not really a big deal since DoorDash exists and I can just get anything I want sent right to my dorm.
: Yes, please brag more about how rich you are. It is a thing that we very much enjoy hearing about.
scene sleepover3
: Hey! How is taking advantage of the DoorDash Dash Pass for the low, low cost of $9.99 per month bragging about being rich?!
: That's right, Maya! The DoorDash Dash Pass is so cheap right now that virtually anyone can afford it.
: And with new restaurants being added to Dash Pass every day, there has never been a better time to take advantage of the opportunity.
Lessons in Love is not sponsored by nor affiliated with DoorDash.
: What's going on with you two? That's the third advertisement you've spontaneously broken into tonight.
scene sleepover3r
: Is that really it? It felt like more.
: No wonder your family is so rich if you can't even make it through a sleepover without advertising some sort of...app or something.
: Excuse me, Maya, but my family is rich because my father invented unpoppable bubble wrap. And I am very tired of reminding you about this.
: I am very tired of being reminded...
Hi, there! It's your favorite narrator here to confirm that what Ayane just said is true!
The Amamiya family is set for life due to the innovative and fun-destroying mind of her father.
Why would anyone ever think of creating unpoppable bubble wrap, you ask?
Good question!
Unfortunately, I have no idea.
But what I do know is that the answer will be revealed in the upcoming Lessons in Love expansion pack, “A World Without Bubbles!”
Pre-order your copy from GameStop today and unlock three bonus costumes for Ayane’s dad.
scene sleepover4
: Why would someone go out of their way to just...make a normal shipping product worse?
: Especially when you can visit your local FedEx store and ship anything you want for-
: Ami, stop. Ayane, tell us more about why your dad is suddenly an evil human being who hates plastic bubbles.
scene sleepover5
: Uhh...better idea: how about we don't talk about my dad?
: I kind of wanted tonight to be relaxing and fun, and it's not going to be either of those things if I'm forced to talk about my arch nemesis.
scene sleepover6
: Nemesis? Isn’t that taking things a little too far?
: He's still your dad at the end of the day. Even if he's a giant jerk butt now.
: Are you kidding? All he does is drink whiskey and listen to smooth jazz now.
: That is super villain behavior, Ami. He is clearly my nemesis.
: You have a strange idea of what constitutes a “super villain” but okay.
: Smooth jazz? Is normal jazz...too rough for some people or something?
scene sleepover8
: It’s seriously unbearable. Like, he won't even listen to my favorite song when I ask him to.
: I have heard your favorite song and want to make it formally known that I am on his side.
: That's fine because Ami is still on my side. Right, Ami?
: Umm...
scene sleepover8r
: Ahh! You’re so lucky! You get to live with Sensei and all I get is a borderline alcoholic with poor taste in music!
scene sleepover9
: What is your fascination with him, anyway? He’s just some...normal old guy who also happens to be our teacher.
: Is that really all you look for in a partner? Age and...age?
: Maya, are you ever going to warm up to him?...
: You two have known each other for years and I've only really seen him be nice to you.
: Just being nice isn’t a good enough reason to like someone. If it was, I’d like pretty much everybody. Do you think I have the energy for that?
scene sleepover10
: It's hard to put into words...but my fascination with him runs way deeper than just his age and his occupation.
: Sensei...is everything I like in a man. No- he's everything I like in a person.
: He’s smart...and he’s kind...and he’s funny...and-
: Twice your age.
scene sleepover11
: Age is just a number, Maya! If Sensei wants me, Sensei can have me!
scene sleepover12
: I really don't think you should be the one saying age is just a number in this situation...
: Besides, it won't be weird at all a few years from now.
: No, it definitely still will.
: Nuh-uh! We'll have a house...a dog...seven children-
scene sleepover13
: Seven?!
: Just what the heck do you think you're planning on doing with my uncle, Ayane?!
: Do you really think I would allow seven children?!
: Wording it like that makes it sound like you'd be okay with less...
: Answer me, damn it! What are you planning on doing, Ayane?!
scene sleepover14
: Showering him with my unconditional love!
scene sleepover15
: And what if he doesn't want your unconditional love?!
scene sleepovergun
: Then I end my life the only way I know how.
scene sleepover16
: You really need to stop carrying that thing around. You're going to accidentally hurt someone one day.
: Where did you even get that? Aren't guns illegal in Japan?
scene sleepover17
: Nothing is illegal when you're rich, unfortunately.
: What do you mean unfortunately?
: Well, the getting anything you want part isn't unfortunate. But the being rich part kind of is in a...really roundabout way that you can't really complain about without people thinking you suck.
: Like, the only person in the mansion who even pays attention to me anymore is Geoffrey. And you know how Geoffrey is.
Hey! Narrator again. Just figured I'd clue you in on Geoffrey since you haven't had the pleasure of meeting him yet.
He's actually a really great guy if you can look past all the scars!
Geoffrey is an American immigrant who works and lives in the Amamiya mansion.
His family was brutally murdered many years ago and he is currently working as a butler while devising a plan to avenge them!
But that's all I'm allowed to tell you for now since I signed an NDA!
Don't worry, though! You can find out more by preordering the upcoming Lessons in Love expansion pack, “A World Without Geoffrey’s Family!”
And if you pre-order your copy from GameStop today, you'll unlock three bonus coffins for Geoffrey’s wife!
scene sleepover19
: Geoffrey! I miss him. How is he doing?
: Did he ever get that thing with the Irish mafia sorted out?
: Yeah, I remember him being really intense about it the last time I came over.
: I think so. He disappeared for a few days a month or two ago and came back covered in blood, but he seems fine now.
scene sleepover23
: And on that note, I'm hungry.
: Blood made you hungry?
: Everything makes me hungry. Were we still planning on going to that cafe Rin works at?
: Didn’t you just eat karaage at the karaoke place like, two hours ago? Can't we wait a little longer?
: Ami, I’m really going to need you to stop judging me if this friendship is going to continue.
: Just eat something here. It's basically your house too, so you can help yourself to anything you can find in the fridge or the pantry.
: I hope you realize how dangerous what you just said to me is.
scene sleepover24
: I can heat something up for Maya. I have to get up to go to the bathroom anyway.
: Can you microwave some popcorn while you're in the kitchen as well? Sensei says that watching a movie without popcorn is a sin and I don't want God to kill me.
: I second the popcorn motion, but for reasons not pertaining to any higher power.
scene black
: Yup! I'll be back in a few, so don't miss me too much!
: Bring drinks too. As quickly as possible. I require all of them.
: Maybe we should just buy a second fridge for you to use whenever you come over?...
Roughly thirty seconds later...
scene newchu1
: Wha-
: Oh. Hey, Ayane.
: The bathroom is in use right now.
scene newchu2
scene newchu1
scene newchu3
: That...
: That's a really big penis...
: Thanks. I appreciate that.
scene newchu4
: Okay. I'm gonna go die now.
: Okay. I'll be out of here in a few minutes if you need to use the bathroom.
: You can't pee when you're dead, Sensei.
scene newchu5
: No...No, I guess you can't.

: OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD.
: That happened. That just happened. I saw it. I actually saw it. He saw me see it. I saw him see me see it. Oh my god.
: How long did I stare for? Seconds? Minutes? Days? What time is it? What am I doing here? Who am I?
: All I know is penis. All I know is penis. All I know is penis. All I know is-
: Uhh...what the fuck are you doing?
scene newchu7
: I don't know anymore, Maya.
: It happened so quickly...I couldn't even think straight.
: It's like...my mind was telling me to move forward. But before I knew it, I was out here in the hallway again...contemplating life and what has become of me.
: You were gone for literally two minutes.
scene newchu8
: That's it?! It felt like I was in there for days!
: Okay well, you're being gross and I'm just going to make my own food because this is obviously about something I am very much not interested in.
: Will you sleep next to me tonight? I don't know if I'll be able to fall asleep if I'm by myself. I just...keep seeing it. It's in my head, Maya. It's in my head.
: What is in your head? What are you- oh.
scene newchu9
: Do you...think Ami has also seen-
: Shut up. Shut up, shut up, shut up. I never heard this and I am now going to go back to the reason I came out here.
: Goodbye and please don't ever bring this up again. Thanks.
: Oh my god...Oh my god...Oh my god...
: Oh my god...

And that was the first time Ayane ever saw a penis in real life...
Some say, she's still immobilized outside of that bathroom door to this very day...
label afterbrscene:
scene bedroom_night
I walk into my room and immediately collapse onto the bed.
I have no idea what the future implications of Ayane walking in on me are but, if there is anyone that is bound to be okay with something like that, it's her.
I can't say I expected her to just run away, though. And, who knows? Maybe if she actually knew what she was walking into, she wouldn't have run at all.
Regardless, I have no regrets and I am glad we got this out of the way sooner rather than later.
Because even if nothing comes of it, I know for a fact that the image of me is now engraved into her mind.
Either way, my new life of attempted debauchery and depravity begins tomorrow.
Ayane just happened to get a bit of a head start to the party.
scene black
Goodnight, world.
Please keep whatever dreams you were thinking of gracing me with to yourself, for I am about to fall asleep in one-
One that I will hopefully remain in forever.
I will make the most of this life.
I will live for myself.
And if others get hurt in the process, I will do what I do best and write them off.
A voice in the back of my mind reminds me that none of this is real.
A second one fights against it.
A third carries me off to sleep.
$ sleepover = True
From this point on, you will be able to make decisions that will impact your relationships with every character in the game.
Weekends will give you a morning, afternoon, and night phase.
Each phase gives you time to hang out with one girl. But each girl is only available at specific times in specific places each day.
You will eventually have the option to call the girls and bypass this, but you must first acquire their phone numbers.
You will soon find that certain actions or certain events will require you to be in the right place at the right time.
And if you get lost, remember that's exactly where I want you.
On school days, you will only be able to act freely at night. The morning and afternoon will be consumed by class and counseling.
Remember, many events in this game will be locked behind others. Focusing on one character is both not advised and not possible.
Oh, but remember this more than anything else-
This world was made for you.
Please enjoy it to your heart’s content.
